selection_policy: Three diagnostic cases selected after WanLoRA/R1 official scores, before reading R10A official scores; choices cover an instruction/physics tradeoff, interaction improvement with residual defects, and R1 regression. Not a representative sample or a new numeric benchmark.
scope: Inspection of existing generated video frames; no new generation, model download, API call or scorer changes. Fast/transient defects between sampled times may be missed.

ozHyEwawtZA_000479_000489.request: The woman places a baking tray into the oven.
ozHyEwawtZA_000479_000489.wan_lora: A new foreground woman brings a tray toward the viewer; the requested placement into an oven is not visible in the eight sampled frames.
ozHyEwawtZA_000479_000489.r1: A foreground woman likewise brings a paper-lined tray toward the camera. This differs from the requested placement into the oven; a local visual-quality score gain does not establish action compliance.
ozHyEwawtZA_000479_000489.r10a: The two original women and kitchen remain very similar across the sequence. No clear tray-into-oven process appears in the sampled frames.
ozHyEwawtZA_000479_000489.finding: The instruction failure is visible despite different amounts of scene/action change; low artifact opportunity alone is not successful physical execution.

bridge_3357.request: The robotic arm opens the cardboard box.
bridge_3357.wan_lora: The box becomes open around the middle-to-late frames; an oversized white articulated hand/arm appears, with abrupt geometry/occlusion changes. Opening occurs but the interaction is not clean.
bridge_3357.r1: A dark gripper contacts the top before the box becomes open, giving a clearer local relation to the action. The large gripper/arm geometry changes sharply around frame57 and a different thin tool remains later. The physical/temporal passes do not mean artifact-free execution.
bridge_3357.r10a: The taped cardboard box remains closed at all eight sampled times; a small gripper appears near the lower edge later. The central requested state change is absent.
bridge_3357.finding: Useful local R1 interaction and its remaining geometry defects coexist. Static preservation in R10A must not count as fulfilling the opening request.

92ec5d48-97a1-426a-b4e3-818e4d4ac5cf.request: The character reveals a surprised face reflecting on the metallic surface.
92ec5d48-97a1-426a-b4e3-818e4d4ac5cf.wan_lora: A surprised face appears, but the metal becomes a frame-like opening around the mouth and the head extends beyond it. This is not a clean reflection on an intact metallic surface.
92ec5d48-97a1-426a-b4e3-818e4d4ac5cf.r1: A disconnected mouth first appears on the metal; later the face overlaps/extends beyond the held surface. The reflection and face geometry are defective.
92ec5d48-97a1-426a-b4e3-818e4d4ac5cf.r10a: The metallic sheet and hands remain almost unchanged in these frames; no surprised reflected face is visible.
92ec5d48-97a1-426a-b4e3-818e4d4ac5cf.finding: All three miss part of the intended process for different reasons. More change alone is insufficient; unchanged structure without the requested reflection also fails.

implications: Keep instruction, physical plausibility and appearance/temporal consistency separate in reporting.
These examples provide concrete evidence that requested state changes can be absent while shape/background are stable, and that visible action can coexist with geometry artifacts.
Do not infer every R10A clip is static or every R1 physics gain is valid from these selected cases.
Use the complete R13A40/controls and actual-video review before selecting R13B; these supplementary findings do not authorize skipping the sequential decision.

official_evaluator_context.interpretation: Official instruction evaluates the requested goal separately. The five physics and two commonsense questions ask about visible violations/defects; no detected violation is not a positive test that the requested state transition occurred. Preserve official scores, read them jointly with instruction and actual video evidence.
official_evaluator_context.observed_ceiling: In both completed WanLoRA and R1 fixed70 results, newton/fluid/gravity each average1.0; discrimination of their physical sum currently comes from mass/deformation and penetration. This does not invalidate the benchmark or establish perfect physics.
